{
  "extract_plan": {
    "chunk_summary": "RFC 9309 §2–2.2.2: defines the robots.txt protocol language (rules and groups), gives the ABNF formal syntax, and states normative requirements for product tokens, user-agent line matching, and group merging."
  },
  "concepts": [
    {
      "id": "c-protocol-language",
      "name": "protocol language",
      "aliases": ["robots exclusion protocol language"],
      "description": "The language of the robots exclusion protocol, made up of rules and groups served in a robots.txt file.",
      "anchor": "The protocol language consists of",
      "location": "rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol#c0004"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-rule",
      "name": "rule",
      "aliases": ["Rule"],
      "description": "A key-value line that states how a crawler may access URIs.",
      "anchor": "consists of rule(s)",
      "location": "rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol#c0004"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-group",
      "name": "group",
      "aliases": ["Group"],
      "description": "One or more user-agent lines followed by rules, terminated by a user-agent line or end of file.",
      "anchor": "and group(s) that the",
      "location": "rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol#c0004"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-robots-txt",
      "name": "robots.txt",
      "aliases": ["robots.txt file"],
      "description": "The file the service makes available in which the protocol language is expressed.",
      "anchor": "a file named \"robots.txt\"",
      "location": "rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol#c0004"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-product-token",
      "name": "product token",
      "aliases": ["product-token"],
      "description": "The name a crawler sets for itself, used to find the groups in robots.txt that apply to it.",
      "anchor": "which is called a product token",
      "location": "rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol#c0004"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-user-agent-line",
      "name": "user-agent line",
      "aliases": ["startgroupline"],
      "description": "The line that starts a group and carries a product token; it also terminates a preceding group.",
      "anchor": "terminated by a user-agent line",
      "location": "rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol#c0004"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-crawler",
      "name": "crawler",
      "aliases": ["robot", "bot"],
      "description": "The automated client that fetches URIs and is expected to find and obey the matching robots.txt group.",
      "anchor": "purpose of the crawler",
      "location": "rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol#c0004"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-user-agent-header",
      "name": "User-Agent header",
      "aliases": ["User-Agent HTTP header"],
      "description": "The HTTP identification header in which the product token should appear as a substring.",
      "anchor": "the User-Agent header",
      "location": "rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol#c0004"
    },
    {
      "id": "c-allow-disallow-lines",
      "name": "\"Allow\" and \"Disallow\" Lines",
      "aliases": ["allow and disallow lines"],
      "description": "The rule lines indicating whether accessing a URI matching the corresponding path is allowed or disallowed.",
      "anchor": "The \"Allow\" and \"Disallow\" Lines",
      "location": "rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol#c0004"
    }
  ],
  "definitions": [
    {
      "id": "d-rule",
      "term": "Rule",
      "verbatim_text": "A line with a key-value pair that defines how a crawler may access URIs.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "Rule:  A line with a key-value pair",
      "location": "rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol#c0004"
    },
    {
      "id": "d-group",
      "term": "Group",
      "verbatim_text": "One or more user-agent lines that are followed by one or more rules.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "Group:  One or more user-agent lines",
      "location": "rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol#c0004"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "cl-product-token-charset",
      "claim_text": "The product token MUST contain only uppercase and lowercase letters (\"a-z\" and \"A-Z\"), underscores (\"_\"), and hyphens (\"-\").",
      "claim_type": "normative",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "MUST contain only uppercase",
      "location": "rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol#c0004"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl-product-token-substring",
      "claim_text": "The product token SHOULD be a substring of the identification string that the crawler sends to the service.",
      "claim_type": "normative",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "SHOULD be a substring of the identification",
      "location": "rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol#c0004"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl-case-insensitive-matching",
      "claim_text": "Crawlers MUST use case-insensitive matching to find the group that matches the product token and then obey the rules of the group.",
      "claim_type": "normative",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "MUST use case-insensitive matching",
      "location": "rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol#c0004"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl-merge-groups",
      "claim_text": "If there is more than one group matching the user-agent, the matching groups' rules MUST be combined into one group and parsed according to Section 2.2.2.",
      "claim_type": "normative",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "MUST be combined into one group",
      "location": "rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol#c0004"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl-star-group-fallback",
      "claim_text": "If no matching group exists, crawlers MUST obey the group with a user-agent line with the \"*\" value, if present.",
      "claim_type": "normative",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "If no matching group exists",
      "location": "rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol#c0004"
    },
    {
      "id": "cl-no-rules-apply",
      "claim_text": "If no group matches the product token and there is no group with a user-agent line with the \"*\" value, or no groups are present at all, no rules apply.",
      "claim_type": "normative",
      "evidence_grade": "practitioner_assertion",
      "anchor": "no rules apply",
      "location": "rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol#c0004"
    }
  ],
